$comment: Files the license-header gate must NOT touch. Every entry needs a reason.
The load-bearing category is `vendored`: those files are copyright someone
on them would assert ownership we do not have — the compliance failure this
whole effort exists to fix, pointed the other way. If you add a vendored
file, add it here in the same change.

vendored.$reason: Copyright SK Telecom Co., Ltd. — verbatim upstream data files, attributed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md §1. A consistency test pins them byte-identical to a BomLens revision; a header would break that and misstate ownership.

vendored_specs.$reason: Copyright assigned to TRUSCA, but held byte-faithful to the verification team's snapshot by agreement (tests/verify-specs/PROVENANCE.md). No edits of any kind, headers included.

third_party_texts.$reason: Verbatim published license texts, each the work of its own steward (Apache Software Foundation, Free Software Foundation, ...). Not ours to stamp.

generated.$reason: Machine-generated. Alembic writes revision files from a template; a header would be dropped by the next autogenerate and reappear as noise in every migration diff.

derived_dual_copyright.$reason: Adapted from BomLens within the SAME language, so upstream EXPRESSION survives, not just the idea. These carry a dual copyright header (SK Telecom AND TRUSCA) written by hand; the auto-inserter must not overwrite that with our name alone. Contrast the jq-to-Python ports (g7_conformance.py, license_flags.py, ...): a change of language means the expression is ours, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md §1 carries the upstream credit.

position_sensitive_first_line.$reason: cloud-init identifies the payload by its FIRST line (`#cloud-config`); a header above it silently breaks provisioning. It is also our own demo-host bootstrap rather than a product artifact — the same reason deploy/ is out of scope.

ambient_declarations.$reason: A single triple-slash reference directive. No authorship to claim, and the directive is position-sensitive by spec (comments may precede it, but a two-line header over a one-line file is noise either way).

vendored_snapshots.$reason: Data snapshots fetched from upstream APIs, not authored here. Provenance is in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md §1 and in the refresh script's docstring.
